description: This file declares the ClientHandler class and related interfaces for managing WebRTC client connections, including media tracks, data channels, and signaling within the cuttlefish project.

classes.name: ClientHandler
classes.description: Manages WebRTC client connection, media tracks, data channels, and signaling.

classes.name: ClientVideoTrackInterface
classes.description: Interface for client video track handling, allowing adding or updating sinks.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate a ClientHandler with specified parameters.

methods.name: AddDisplay
methods.description: Adds a video track display with a label.

methods.name: AddAudio
methods.description: Adds an audio track with a label.

methods.name: GetCameraStream
methods.description: Returns the camera video stream interface.

methods.name: SendMessage
methods.description: Sends signaling messages to the client.

methods.name: Build
methods.description: Builds and returns a configured PeerConnection.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Disconnects the client by cleaning up resources.

methods.name: LogAndReplyError
methods.description: Logs an error message and replies to the client.

methods.name: AddTrackToConnection
methods.description: Adds a media track to the peer connection.
